dialogues.text: "This bulletin board will display notices from the Courier's Longhouse as well as other courier-related inquiries. If you have any queries, please contact the maintenance staff."

dialogues.speaker: Couriers' Announcement
dialogues.text: "If you're looking to hire a courier, please head over to the Courier's Longhouse and find the manager, Michica. We only accept commissions on a per-delivery basis, and do not currently offer our services for fixed periods."

dialogues.speaker: Couriers' Announcement
dialogues.text: "Please also note: Couriers should not be entrusted with the delivery of extremely valuable, fragile, or dangerous items."

dialogues.speaker: Couriers' Announcement
dialogues.text: "Though our couriers are highly skilled professionals, and you can rest assured that the vast majority of deliveries will arrive safely, we cannot guarantee against unforeseen accidents that may occur along the way..."

dialogues.speaker: Couriers' Announcement
dialogues.text: "In the past, certain customers have asked our couriers to deliver packages with the speed of a falcon, across distances exceeding the deserts of Sumeru, with no damage to the packaging whatsoever..."

dialogues.speaker: Couriers' Announcement
dialogues.text: "Among today's Scions of the Canopy, only Kinich might be capable of such a task, but sadly he doesn't work as a courier... Anyway, your understanding is greatly appreciated!"

dialogues.speaker: Couriers' Announcement
dialogues.text: "Roll up, roll up, this month's courier performance rankings are out! Star courier Adama, who's been busy preparing for the Pilgrimage, has fallen down to fifth place!"

dialogues.speaker: Couriers' Announcement
dialogues.text: "The champion's position has been seized by none other than her teammate Zeila, who completed an astonishing 110 long-distance deliveries in just twenty days!"

dialogues.speaker: Couriers' Announcement
dialogues.text: "Could it be that Zeila has been treating delivering letters and packages as a form of training!? Unbelievable stuff... I'm starting to feel bad for the opponents she'll be facing in the upcoming Pilgrimage!"

dialogues.speaker: Couriers' Announcement
dialogues.text: "Ranked second to tenth, in the following order, we have: Tundama, Sausa, Sibu... All these couriers will receive a cash prize, plus a special "Yum Yum Yumkasaur" Chew Stick that Aclla made from the finest quality Cacahuatl!"

dialogues.speaker: Couriers' Announcement
dialogues.text: "Other fellow couriers, don't lose heart! Keep up the great work — maybe next month, the award will be yours!"

dialogues.speaker: Couriers' Announcement
dialogues.text: "Now that Michica has submitted the assessment report to Chief Wayna, the bidding process for the next generation of couriers' standard issue gear is about to begin."

dialogues.speaker: Couriers' Announcement
dialogues.text: "As per usual, before finalizing the bidding requirements, we will first gather feedback from the couriers. We encourage you all to share your thoughts—"

dialogues.speaker: Couriers' Announcement
dialogues.text: "Let us know which parts of the protective gear are more prone to damage, where screws tend to fall out, and which materials are less resistant to corrosion from moisture and Gaseous Phlogiston... Also, which safety ropes have poor weight-to-durability ratios. The more detailed the feedback, the better."

dialogues.speaker: Couriers' Announcement
dialogues.text: "We are well aware that the current usage rate of the standard issue gear is not very high, so we are determined to improve it to ensure that the management fees you all contribute are put to better use!"

dialogues.speaker: Couriers' Announcement
dialogues.text: "Please don't hesitate to share as many suggestions as possible to let Miss Amauta know what you value the most!"

dialogues.speaker: Couriers' Announcement
dialogues.text: "To all couriers delivering to the Flower-Feather Clan: Please ensure that you drop off your deliveries BEFORE engaging in racing contests with members of the Flower-Feather Clan."

dialogues.speaker: Couriers' Announcement
dialogues.text: "Otherwise, not only will you most likely lose, given how skilled they are at gliding, but on top of that, you might also damage the contents of your packages. It's just not worth the risk!"
